subject: Interview invitation: Marketing Intern at Peachtree Brands
body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for your application. We'd like to invite you to interview for the Marketing Intern position with our brand team. The conversation is 30 minutes over Zoom with me and our Senior Brand Manager.

Please use the link below to schedule an interview at a time that works for you this week or next:
https://calendly.example.com/peachtree/intern-interviews

Looking forward to meeting you,

Dana Whitfield
University Recruiter, Peachtree Brands
